title: Turkey, prepackaged deli, luncheon meat, reduced sodium (1015)

content.title: About
content.content: Turkey deli meat is a ready‑to‑eat sliced turkey product designed for sandwiches and snacks. The reduced‑sodium version (1015) contains about 1015 mg of sodium per 100 g, allowing lower salt intake without sacrificing flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey is one of the leanest poultry meats, low in fat.
The slices are often smoked, giving a distinctive taste without a large amount of salt.
Sodium reduction is achieved by using salt substitutes and longer marination.
Reduced‑sodium turkey is popular in diet plans and sodium‑reduction programs.
The product is typically vacuum‑packed, extending shelf life.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Turkey contains less saturated fat than most red meats, supporting heart health.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Provides about 20 g of complete protein per 100 g, essential for tissue repair.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Supplies vitamin B6 and niacin, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Lower salt content helps manage blood pressure and reduces kidney strain.

items.title: Source of selenium
items.content: Selenium supports immune function and antioxidant protection.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to turkey.

items.title: Preservative content
items.content: Certain versions may contain nitrites or other preservatives; check labels if you are sensitive.

items.title: Possible contamination
items.content: As a ready‑made product, improper storage can lead to microbial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Use turkey slices in sandwiches, salads, wraps, or as a cold appetizer. Slice thinly for deli boards, melt briefly on hot sandwiches, or serve chilled with vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in the original packaging. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
